description: This file defines the 'DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute' and 'DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes' enum within the System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis namespace. It provides attributes for indicating which members of a type may be accessed dynamically, primarily used to assist static analysis or tooling detection of reflection usage in .NET applications.

classes.name: DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute
classes.description: An attribute indicating which members of a type are accessed dynamically via reflection.

methods.name: DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with specified member types.
